description: This source file defines API endpoints using FastAPI for managing message threads and messages in a messaging component of a backend service. It includes route handlers for listing threads, listing messages within a thread, and sending messages, all with dependency injection for authentication.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to list messages within a specific thread.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to send a message, creating a new message in a thread or a new thread.
